settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure your application preferences, notifications, and integrations.

natural.name: Pawbby Natural
natural.label: Plant-based starch pellets
natural.tip: Lowest weight threshold. Recommended default if using lightweight or flushable litter to avoid false low-litter warnings.

tofu.name: Tofu Litter
tofu.label: Flushable cylindrical rods
tofu.tip: Standard cylindrical pea/tofu rods. Ensures proper sifting speed and weight tracking.

bentonite.name: Bentonite Clay
bentonite.label: Classic clumping sand
bentonite.tip: Requires a denser fill (~3.8–4.5 kg). If your box triggers a low litter alert with light clay, switch to Pawbby Natural or tare the scale.

mixed.name: Mixed Blend
mixed.label: Tofu rods + clay granules
mixed.tip: Composite blend of tofu pellets and bentonite granules. Balanced weight profile.
